title: Buffalo Chicken Salad with Blue Cheese and Celery
changes_from_base: Hot sauce and blue cheese flavour a soured-cream dressing, carrot joins the celery, and the herbs are left out.
summary: Shredded chicken in a creamy blue cheese and hot sauce dressing with crunchy celery and carrot, piled on shredded romaine.

ingredients.item: celery sticks, halved lengthways and sliced

steps.title: Poach and shred
steps.text: Cover the chicken and bay leaf with cold water in a lidded pan and bring just to a shiver over medium heat. Lid on, heat off: after 15-17 min the thickest breast should read 74 °C. Leave to cool for 15 min and shred with two forks.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, soured cream, blue cheese, hot sauce, vinegar and pepper; it should stay a little chunky.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Fold the chicken, celery and carrot through the dressing, then chill 20 min.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile onto shredded romaine and crumble over the remaining blue cheese, with extra hot sauce at the table.

tips: Use a vinegar-based Louisiana-style hot sauce for the classic flavour.
Leave the blue cheese a little chunky.
Great in a wrap or a toasted roll.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
